headline.en: Spatial audio advances, polygon synthesis, and agentic post-production
headline.zh: 空间音频、多边形合成与智能后期制作新进展

summary.en: This week's additions include five papers spanning spatial audio, polygon synthesis, and agentic post-production, plus one verified implementation for the arbitrary polygon oscillator. CSAVocoder also has a public project page, but no source code is available there yet.
summary.zh: 本周新增 5 篇论文，涵盖空间音频、多边形合成与智能后期制作，并核验收录了任意多边形振荡器的开源实现。CSAVocoder 目前已有公开项目页，但其中尚未发布源码。

note.en: CSAVocoder enables real-time spatial audio generation from mel-spectrograms with a causal GAN and spatial consistency discriminator.
note.zh: CSAVocoder 利用因果 GAN 和空间一致性判别器实现从梅尔频谱图实时生成空间音频。

note.en: Introduces YT-SPEECH dataset and a Localizer-Renderer framework for visually-guided spatial audio from 360-degree video and omnidirectional audio.
note.zh: 提出了 YT-SPEECH 数据集和定位器-渲染器框架，从360度视频和全向音频生成视觉引导的空间音频。

note.en: RIME uses POEMS to generate paired edit-instruction data, enabling large-scale agentic music post-production and evaluation of multimodal LLMs.
note.zh: RIME 利用 POEMS 生成配对编辑指令数据，支持大规模智能体音乐后期制作并评估多模态大语言模型。
